about: Curated facts for docs/backend/inventory.md. The generator scripts/backend-inventory.mjs combines this file with the workspace, the module registry, and OWNERS. Edit this file, then run: node scripts/backend-inventory.mjs

statusLabels.legacy-active: Older structure that still receives features. Extend it with care and move code out when you touch it.
statusLabels.legacy-frozen: Code with an announced successor. Do not add features here.
statusLabels.extracted: A focused package or module. This is the target shape for new code.
statusLabels.experimental: Behind a flag or opt-in. Not on by default.
statusLabels.deprecated: Marked deprecated in the code. Scheduled for removal.
